content: Implemented shared OfflineExporter over PlaybackSnapshot with selectable full/range rendering and PCM16/float32 WAV output. CLI `export_wav` mixes project clips with placement, trim and gain into a master snapshot and reports rate/channels/frames; GUI exposes selected-clip PCM16 export. Deterministic tests verify exact float range metadata/samples and PCM16 parity against real-time PlaybackRenderer within quantization tolerance. Real demo smoke: imported demo_assets/LightCannon_A_Shoot.wav, added clip, exported target/demo-smoke/demo-export.wav as 48 kHz stereo PCM16, 96,000 frames, 384,044 bytes. `cargo quality` passed format, Clippy -D warnings, 44 tests, and bench compilation.
